articles.author: Josephine Walker
articles.title: JD Vance says he won't watch livestream execution of Fort Hood shooter - Axios
articles.description: Vance urged Americans not to forget the Fort Hood shooter's victims.
articles.content: What they're saying: "Whatever the controversy is about the method of the execution, I hope that people don't forget that this is a guy who brutally murdered a lot of innocent people," Vance told rep… [+1985 chars]
